text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock E, B, and D at gains felt rewarding, but I should not sell solely to make a gain feel real; consider each holding's prospects and my overall plan.","After my early sales, I held through small ups and downs and the account value remained above where it started. Infrequent trading can suit me, so I need not react to every monthly change.","I should review the whole account, not treat each stock as a separate scorecard: avoid letting either the pleasure of a gain or the pain of a loss alone decide what I do."]}
